name: Fetch web page
description: Fetch a public web page and return its readable text.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Read a public web page (http/https) and return its readable plain text, with the page title. Use this whenever the user gives you a URL or asks for current information from the web. Private, loopback and internal addresses are refused.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of extracted text to return (default 20000, hard cap 60000).
